correctness.rationale: Independently re-ran all 10 scripts: all print their *_OK lines. Verified exactly over Q (Fraction): f(-2)=f(2)=f(-1)=f(0)=f(1)=1, f(3)=121, f(-7/4)=4489/1024=(67/32)^2, f(4/9)=139129/59049=(373/243)^2, giving 16 distinct affine Q-points + 1 smooth infinity = 17 total, refuting admitted 'exactly 6 affine + inf'. Discriminant recomputed 38569 and primality confirmed (sympy + trial division); 38569 mod 7 = 6 so p=7 good; #C(F7)=13 affine +1 =14 recomputed. Coleman 1985 bound (r<g, p>2g good: 7>4) gives rank-1 ceiling 14+2=16 < 17 exhibited, so rank>=2 conditional only on the cited theorem; counting (projective vs affine) handled via odd-degree infinity analysis. Rank>=1 via D=[(0,1)]-[inf] with #J(F5)=71 prime and #J(F11)=136 (both confirmed by two independent exact enumerations: (N1^2+N2)/2-p formula and direct Mumford enumeration) plus formal-group prime-to-p torsion argument is sound. Torsion-freeness from gcd(71,136)=1 with 5/11-part elimination is sound. Galois S5 via mod-2 irreducible (transitive), mod-7 [1,4] 4-cycle, mod-11 [1,1,3] 3-cycle (all re-verified via sympy factor_list), unramified (p not | disc), transitive-subgroup elimination (only S5 has elements of order 4 and 3) is sound. Bounded windows independently extended by auditor: exhaustive coprime search to H<=2000 finds exactly the 8 x-values; isqrt scan to |x|<=200000 finds exactly x in {-2,-1,0,1,2,3}. No full-census or exact-rank value is claimed.

originality.rationale: EMERGENT_FINDING route: report declares EMERGENT_FINDING with discovery context (height enumeration returned 8 x-values, Coleman cross-check refuted rank-1 premise); verified it genuinely arose from the target census investigation on the same curve and method family, a harder (not easier) outcome, so absence from topic.json is not adverse. Live-retrieval union (Exa general without category restriction for literal, equivalent, and dominance forms + OpenAlex/Crossref cross-checks + direct database attempts) finds only: Math.SE Galois-group thread (S5 discussion, no rational points), calculus-plot/textbook mentions of the polynomial, general method papers (Coleman 1985 bound, Stoll rank-1 algorithm, Bruin-Stoll sieve, Balakrishnan-Tuitman machinery, Booker et al database paper), and unrelated discriminant-38569 hits (different polynomial x^5-5x^3+4x-1 in an exceptional-units table; quintic-field period paper). No source states the 10 extra affine points, the 17-point floor, rank>=2, torsion-freeness, or the #J(Fp) table for this model. LMFDB API was unavailable (SSL mismatch / JS gate, recorded) but Exa-indexed LMFDB pages show only generic search interface, no model-specific census; in any case a conditional database point list would not substantively imply the certified refutation + rank-floor proof. All failure modes tested (see decisive_checks); none covers the claim.

value.rationale: EMERGENT_FINDING gets no preset-value presumption; judged under ordinary standard. The result is a rigorously established exact correction of a motivated benchmark object (admitted rank-boundary genus-2 quintic): 10 new verified affine points, a Coleman-based rank>=2 floor blocking any rank-1 Chabauty pipeline, torsion-freeness, S5 Galois data, a doubly-enumerated #J(Fp) table, and bounded-search windows reusable for the now-required rank>=2 (e.g. quadratic-Chabauty) attack. Object and invariants were motivated before computation, values are not known or mechanically implied (generic Coleman bound at p=7 is 16, far from implying the 17-point exhibition; non-integral points x=-7/4, 4/9 are non-obvious), and a future researcher could reasonably need the precise floor. Not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration. Incomplete census honestly disclosed and not claimed; headline floor is self-contained and independently retrievable.

Bounded-search windows (H(x)<=2000, |x|<=200000) are finite completeness windows, not a full census; full list completeness, exact rank value, and rank>=2 Chabauty analysis are explicitly left open.
